text: Long ago, this world was perfectly harmonious.
The Hoppits kept time like metronomes,
the Tallhorn held long notes as smooth as strings,
and the Swamp Heralds’ low frequencies could shake a concert hall.
She sang so horribly off-pitch that the entire world went crooked!
<link=wiggle>In this moment of crisis, you were chosen to wield a legendary DJ deck.</link>
With it, you can tune the world and blast off-key monsters back on pitch.
You’ll restore harmony to the land and find the Princess to tell her --
Please… you’re really out of tune.
